cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Tell Me I Did Enough
cards.instruction: Get someone to reassure you that your effort, choice, or survival was enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I made it through the speech without leaving. Was that enough? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I know. I'm asking about staying.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You stayed all the way through. I'll help you practise the missing bit tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could staying earn me tomorrow off? Tell me I can put the speech away.

mechanism: A directs the post-speech debrief, accepting limited corrective work while seeking permission to count having stayed as enough.
confusable: Unlike asking whether performance was perfect, A seeks reassurance that completing the ordeal counts; borrowed authority adapts the review plan to keep B answering that question.
comparison: Endurance through a speech differs from whether one painting earns space in a shared show.
seedUse: Use D100-b speech/missing paragraph/staying/practice/day off with S02-b flexible debrief terms.
